The owner excluded 18 pairs with a note about commas and noted a 19th (sc-051, kept) the same way (ids in pairs_noted_for_commas). Rewrite them with no commas or almost none. Owner's words in chat, 2026-11-08: 'it was weird that you had mispelling alongisde perfect comma grammar. I feel like people are more likely to not have commas at all in terms of how they type'.
No hyphenated compounds that read as written rather than typed: 'eight-year-old', 'right-side', 'outward-turned' (sc-029, sc-030).
Body words: a patient would say 'ball' or 'one of my balls', not 'testicle' (sc-010).

Drug and condition names: a patient may not name 'methimazole for hyperthyroidism' (sc-032) or 'hemophilia' (sc-026); prefer how a patient would refer to their medicine or condition, or keep the name only where patients commonly know it.
Pairs the owner marked right may be extended as before; the excluded ones are counter-examples (their notes say what to avoid).
